description: Sends one developer message to the in-app inbox of ALL users of an app, or of one group; no email or push, no recall. Each recipient costs daily-quota credits: price it with neblla_broadcast_read estimate. Without confirm: true nothing is sent. Runs in the background, one per app; if the quota runs out it pauses (stopped_quota) and goes on after 00:00 UTC, or sooner with "resume" (no confirm needed). Needs the inbox module. More: neblla_get_llms tools/broadcast

action.description: What to do. By action: send {same fields}; resume {id}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

confirm.description: true sends. Only after the developer agreed.

data.description: JSON payload for the app to render.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

group.description: Only this group's members (neblla_group); left out: every user.

id.description: resume: the send's id, from neblla_broadcast_read list.

role.description: With group: only members with this role.

name: neblla_broadcast
title: Send a broadcast
